Smith Mills is a census-designated place (CDP) in the town of Dartmouth in Bristol County, Massachusetts, United States. The population was 4,760 at the 2010 census.


== Geography ==
Smith Mills is located at 41°38′23″N 70°59′4″W (41.639807, -70.984491).According to the United States Census Bureau, the CDP has a total area of 12.4 km2 (4.8 mi2).
